findings.message: `test_rework_remains_unreachable_from_the_production_root` asserts that `squatch.rework` is not in the import closure of `squatch.__main__`. Scheduler-activation makes `squatch.daemon` reachable from that root. Rework-activation then wires Rework into the real daemon composition, so this negative test must be migrated. The plan says 'activation migrates every named negative assertion'. The ticket only says rework activation 'preserves its direct post-admission contracts', and its third acceptance criterion pins a dormancy migration for merge-queue-activation only. As written, the emitted rework-activation seed and `tests/test_seeded_phase3_06.py` would neither name nor pin this migration.
findings.paved_road: In Scope in and the predecessor-closure acceptance criterion, name `test_rework_remains_unreachable_from_the_production_root` in `tests/test_rework.py` (already inside the rework-activation fence) as the dormancy assertion rework-activation migrates. Its direct post-admission contracts stay preserved. Require `tests/test_seeded_phase3_06.py` to pin that the emitted rework-activation seed names this migration, the same way it pins the merge-queue `not hasattr(pipeline, "merge_queue")` migration.
